lines.TYPE_QUESTION: Type your question, then tap Go.
lines.CHOOSE_BOX: Tap a box, then use the number pad.
lines.TRY_FIRST: Try this step. I am here when you want help.
lines.ADD_PLACE: Add the digits in this place.
lines.CARRY_RULE: When a column makes ten or more, write the ones and carry the tens.
lines.SUBTRACT_PLACE: Subtract the digits in this place.
lines.BORROW_RULE: When the top digit is too small, regroup from the next non-zero place.
lines.MULTIPLY_PLACE: Multiply by one digit at a time.
lines.ALIGN_RULE: Move each new partial product one place left.
lines.ADD_PARTIALS: Add the partial products by place value.
lines.DIVIDE_GROUPS: Find how many whole groups fit.
lines.REMAINDER_RULE: The remainder is what is left after the last whole group.
lines.CHECK_AGAIN: Check this box and try again.
lines.ALL_CORRECT: Every step is correct. You worked it out.
lines.HINT: Here is a hint without the answer.
lines.SHOW_STEP: Let us look at the next step.
lines.GUIDE_ON: Guide mode is on. You still fill each box.
lines.WHOLE_NUMBER_SWAP: This pilot uses whole-number answers. Put the bigger number on top.
lines.DIVIDE_ZERO: We cannot divide by zero. Choose a different divisor.
